svg.title: face1kb training scheme
svg.desc: Training of the face1kb codecs: per-step sampling of crop, resolution bucket and gain level; mean-scale hyperprior with analysis, quantisation, hyperprior and FiLM-conditioned synthesis; ACCURATE identity side-stream from a frozen EdgeFace-S anchor with a refine head; rate-distortion-identity objective and the three-phase identity-weight schedule.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif

svg.text: Training: one variable-rate model per variant

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif

svg.text: Single GPU, step-based. Every step draws a crop, a resolution bucket and one of 8 gain levels, so one network spans all budgets.

svg.text: Adam lr 1e-4, batch 32, fp16 autocast, gradient clipping 1.0; separate Adam 1e-3 for the entropy-bottleneck quantiles.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif

svg.text: Released weights come from warm-start chains (FAST: 1M steps; ACCURATE: 1M schedule stopped at 990k, then extended to 3M on a rebuilt cosine); see docs/training.md.
